simple.meaning: טָפַשׁ (ṭâphash) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, apparently to be thick ; figuratively, to be stupid.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: properly, apparently to be thick ; figuratively, to be stupid
definitions.full: H2954. taphash טָפַשׁ verb be gross (Late Hebrew Hithpa`el grow stupid , and derivatives; Aramaic טְפֵשׁ , for Hebrew שׁמן Isa 6:11 , Ithpe`el be stupid ; compare Assyrian ‰apâšu , be abundant , large , Guy JAS 1883, Août-Sept. 189 ) — metaphor לִבָּ֑ם כַּחֵלֶב טָפַשׁ Psa 119:70 their heart is gross, like fat.

occurrences.englishText: Their heart is as callous as the fat,
